query: SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location = 'madrid') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location NOT IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location = 'madrid') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT tag FROM sensors) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE id = 99) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location NOT IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE id = 99) ORDER BY ts
SELECT s.ts,s.location FROM sensors AS s WHERE s.location IN (SELECT t.location FROM sensors AS t WHERE t.location = 'madrid') ORDER BY s.ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE note = 'IN (SELECT x)' ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT lower(location) FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT concat(location, '!') FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT min(location) FROM sensors) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT first(location) FROM sensors) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT string_agg(location, ',') FROM sensors) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location NOT IN (SELECT lower(location) FROM sensors WHERE id=99) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors GROUP BY location) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT min(location), location FROM sensors GROUP BY location) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT note FROM sensors) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid')) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT s.location FROM sensors s JOIN sensors t ON s.id=t.id) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT t.location FROM sensors s JOIN sensors t ON s.id=t.id) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid') AND location NOT IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='東京') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid') OR location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='東京') ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE NOT (location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors WHERE location='madrid')) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts,location FROM sensors WHERE location IN (SELECT location FROM sensors ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY ts
